pirs.statement: Will the governing bloc (M/KD/L + SD support) maintain voting cohesion on values files (migration HD01SfU35, citizenship HD024194) through the 2026-09-13 election?
pirs.rationale: Cohesion is the arithmetic survival condition for the ~176-seat majority; defection triggers S3 fracture.

pirs.statement: Will a labour-market or macro shock (unemployment rising above ~9% from ~8.3% T+1, or GDP undershoot vs IMF WEO ~2.1% T+1) reframe the campaign toward economic competence (S2)?
pirs.rationale: Highest-leverage synthesis-breaker (wildcard W1); IMF live degraded, figures vintage-pinned.

pirs.statement: Will the municipal equalisation (HD10526) and elder-care (HD01SoU32) reforms become a decisive fairness/competence cleavage in the campaign?
pirs.rationale: Opposition-favourable framing axis; tests welfare-signalling opportunity vs delivery-gap weakness.

pirs.statement: Will agency capacity (Polismyndigheten, Migrationsverket, municipalities) deliver the crime/care/migration reforms, or will implementation gaps produce exploitable delivery failures (T4)?
pirs.rationale: Statskontoret myndighetsanalys is the natural evaluator; capacity is the binding constraint, not legislative will.
